newsitem.title: UK: Citadel plans July AIM float, eyes French offices.
newsitem.headline: Citadel plans July AIM float, eyes French offices.

text.p: Property investment company Citadel Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it plans to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in July and intends to focus on commercial property in France.
Citadel has been formed by CLS Holdings Plc to invest mainly in office buildings in Paris and Lyon where the company believes prices have reached a low point in their cycle.
The new company is looking to raise about 33 million stg which would effectively be its market capitalisation and dealings in the shares are expected to start on July 23.

Citadel said the availability of favourable financing terms in France coupled with property price weakness, had presented an Citadel with an opportunity to provide investors with an above average return.
CLSH Management Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of CLS Holdings, will manage Citadel.
UBS Limited have been appointed nominated advisers to the company.
